dashboard.label: Data Quality
dashboard.description: Polling freshness, sensor errors, and coverage for ZENTRA Cloud weather events.

search.query: | datamodel Weather Weather search | rename "Weather.*" as * | stats count
| datamodel Weather Weather search | rename "Weather.*" as * | stats dc(device_sn) as value
| datamodel Weather Weather search | rename "Weather.*" as * | where error_flag=true OR error_flag="true" OR error_flag=1 | stats count as value

| datamodel Weather Weather search | rename "Weather.*" as * | stats latest(_time) as last_seen max(mrid) as last_mrid count as observations sum(eval(if(error_flag=true OR error_flag="true" OR error_flag=1,1,0))) as error_events by device_sn device_name | eval age_seconds = now() - last_seen | eval stale = if(age_seconds > 1800, "stale", "ok") | convert ctime(last_seen) | sort stale, device_sn

| datamodel Weather Weather search | rename "Weather.*" as * | eval is_error = if(error_flag=true OR error_flag="true" OR error_flag=1, 1, 0) | timechart span=15m sum(is_error) as error_events count as observations by device_sn

| datamodel Weather Weather search | rename "Weather.*" as * | where error_flag=true OR error_flag="true" OR error_flag=1 OR isnotnull(metadata_errors) | table _time, device_sn, sensor_name, error_flag, error_description, metadata_errors, air_temperature, wind_speed | sort - _time
| datamodel Weather Weather search | rename "Weather.*" as * | timechart span=15m count by device_sn
